title: First shoes, then water bottles!

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: We're leaving for the park soon. What do we need?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Good start! What else goes in the bag?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: First my hat, then my toy truck!

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: A truck at the park? Okay, little planner!

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: As soon as my shoes are on, I'm ready!

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Then shoes on! I'll grab the keys.

variations: "shoes and water bottles" 换 "snacks and hats"；"the park" 换 "Grandma's house"。
